quotelist.quote: The Salomon Highpath was built to be the pinnacle in both all mountain performance and sustainable construction.

citation.reasoning: Australian merchant listing for the 2027 model Highpath, confirming brand and model name, as well as preorder status.

quotelist.quote: In this review, I will take a look at the Highpath as a freeride snowboard.

citation.reasoning: SnowboardingProfiles categorizes the Highpath primarily as a freeride board bordering on all-mountain, supporting the board subtype classification.

quotelist.quote: The Highpath is a culmination of our efforts to design a high performance, all-mountain snowboard built with recycled and bio-sourced materials.
50% recycled sintered base: 50% recycled base materials!
Highpath uses 100% recycled materials in the sidewalls, 50% recycled materials in the base, and at least 20% recycled aluminum in the edges.
B/FX stringer: A patented combination of fiberglass and basalt designed to provide an optimal ratio of weight, power, and dampening.
Natural wax: A paraffin-free wax compound made from natural ingredients.
Fine stone finish: Our fine stone finish is particularly efficient on our Sintered EG base.

citation.reasoning: Official Salomon manufacturer product page — highest authority for specifications. Notable that it says 100% recycled sidewalls vs 66% listed on other sources (likely different model year).
